diagnostics.title: Report missing routes, templates, services and translation keys, and duplicate routes

controllerChecks.title: Report route controllers without the named method and deprecated route settings

serviceChecks.title: Report deprecated service classes, duplicate parameters and unknown named arguments

phpCallChecks.title: Report removed form type names, missing assets and unknown translation domains in PHP

twigChecks.title: Report missing routes, assets and translation domains and unknown route comparisons in Twig templates

twigSyntaxChecks.title: Report deprecated for conditions and component syntax mistakes in Twig

yamlSyntaxChecks.title: Report syntax problems in YAML configuration files

commandChecks.title: Report invokable commands without an int return type and invalid console input modes

deprecationChecks.title: Report deprecated Symfony APIs the project's version no longer supports

publicDirectory.title: Public directory that asset() paths start from (project-relative)

compiledContainers.title: Extra compiled container XML files (project-relative, comma-separated)

compiledRoutes.title: Extra compiled route files, like url_generating_routes.php (project-relative, comma-separated)

twigNamespaces.title: Extra Twig namespaces as name=directory pairs (project-relative, comma-separated; an empty name is the main namespace)
